Payback port coverage

Every function of the original Mac OS X build of Payback, one box each, sized by its bytes and coloured by how far the Rust / Bevy port covers it.

Coverage figures exclude grey (not applicable) functions unless noted. The port is behavioural, not a matching decompilation: green means "cited by the port and believed ported", not "proven identical".

Hover a box for details; click to pin it here.
